summary: Backend testing of VCF vCard endpoint bug fix. Verified that GET /api/profile/{user_id}/vcard.vcf correctly embeds photo as base64 JPEG using direct object storage fetch (not HTTP self-call). All 12 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The admin user's photo stored in object storage is very small (1x1 pixel, 634-byte JPEG after conversion). This is likely due to a test/seed photo being uploaded. Real user photos will be larger but the endpoint works correctly regardless.

Note: Both test users (admin and mjeast) have photos set in the DB, so we couldn't test the true 'no photo' path, but the endpoint structure handles it correctly (photo_line stays empty, no PHOTO field in vCard). The code path is covered by inspection.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing admin user (69a0b7095fddcede09591667) which already has a photo, and mjeast user (69c75782e051d06491e6fa9f) which also has a photo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VCF fix verified working: PHOTO field is embedded as PHOTO;ENCODING=b;TYPE=JPEG base64 in vCard 3.0. The fix calls get_object(storage_path) via asyncio.to_thread() instead of httpx self-call. Admin user ID 69a0b7095fddcede09591667 has photo_url='/api/images/imos/profiles/69a0b7095fddcede09591667/895aec0c-4f5e-4193-9981-d97fa634c15f.webp'. Both test users have photos — no user without a photo was found for the no-photo branch test (but endpoint handles it gracefully per code review).
